name: check_no_pii_mergeup_20261105
comment: ANCHOR: FQ-154b — a merge-up cannot introduce exposure the merge target already publishes.
The pre-commit PII gate diffs the index against the branch's first parent, so every file a merge-up brings in
from main read as added and its existing PII lines failed; baseline may only shrink, so a far-behind branch
had no sanctioned way to merge (32 of the 40 oldest PRs). The suite pins the rule: in a merge commit, a
finding whose line is byte-identical at the same path and line in origin/main does not count; a differing
line still counts in full; an ordinary commit is judged exactly as before; an unresolvable origin/main
